# authwise_scopes (Data Source)

An OAuth scope on an audience, and the access permissions it grants. The id is the scope's own name. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `scopes` (Attributes List) Every scope under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Read-Only:

- `auto` (Boolean)
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `scope_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
